# Urban Deals

> Urban Deals curates top-rated Amazon India products with honest buyer reviews, real discounts and daily price checks. Compare, pick and save.

Urban Deals is a shopping deals and product review website for Amazon India. Products are organized into categories, with prices, discounts, ratings and honest buyer reviews. Deals and prices are checked daily and all links point to Amazon India product pages.

## Site

- Homepage: https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/
- All Products: https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/products
- Product Pages: https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/products/{slug}
- Category Pages: https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/category/{slug}

## Pages

- [About](https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/about): Learn about Urban Deals and how we curate deals.
- [Contact](https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/contact): Get in touch with the Urban Deals team.
- [Privacy Policy](https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/privacy): How we handle user data.
- [Disclaimer](https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/disclaimer): Affiliate disclosure and disclaimer.
- [Terms](https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/terms): Terms of service.

## Notes

- Urban Deals participates in the Amazon Associates affiliate program; purchases made through our links may earn us a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.
- Sitemap: https://urbandeals.hardikkamaliya.online/sitemap.xml
- AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) are welcome to index product and category pages.
